title: 5 things advertisers need to know about FAST channels

facts.fact: In Roku's 2026 VOD Evolution survey, 44% of streamers said they find looking for something new to watch 'stressful'.
facts.quote: 44% of streamers told us they find it “stressful” looking for something new to watch

facts.fact: Roku offers more than 200 FAST channels, including French language channels.
facts.quote: Roku offers more than 200 FAST channels, including French language channels

facts.fact: According to a fall 2025 Media Technology Monitor study, 41% of online Canadians now watch FAST channels.
facts.quote: with 41% of online Canadians now watching FAST channels.

facts.fact: According to a fall 2025 Media Technology Monitor study, FAST channel viewing among online Canadians nearly doubled in the year before.
facts.quote: FAST channel viewing among online Canadians nearly doubled in the year before

facts.fact: Roku reports that Canadian streamers spend on average 4 hours and 12 minutes a week watching free streaming with ads, an hour longer than the prior year.
facts.quote: Canadian streamers are spending 4 hours and 12 minutes a week watching free streaming with ads

facts.fact: According to Gracenote research, less than 14% of content on FAST channels was made before 1990.
facts.quote: less than 14% of content on FAST channels was made before 1990

facts.fact: According to Gracenote, 45% of video content on FAST channels was produced after 2019.
facts.quote: nearly half (45%) of the video content on FAST channels was produced after 2019

facts.fact: According to a late 2025 Media in Canada report, Tubi and CBC will be expanding their FAST portfolios.
facts.quote: Tubi will be expanding its FAST portfolio, as will CBC
